name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 8 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-06-11, at wavelengths from 1.23 to 4.75 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
